text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm walking by the track when I
happen
to hear what sounds like a
commotion.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Th-there's a fight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's something I can't overlook. I rush
towards
the source of all the noise, only
to find...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aw yeah, now zat's the spirit! Show me
whatcha
got, and don't either of you
dare lose!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aww, what? A draw? How 'bout you two
settle the
score with a casual race?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yowza! You scared me! But don't be
such a
buzzkill. These two're in the
middle of a fight!
choice_data_list: 無断のレースはよくないぞ
無断のレースはよくないよ
choice_data_list_en: Racing without permission isn't a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Why don'tcha supervise the
race?
Then it'll be a nice 'n proper
scrimmage!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, live a little. Fire and fight is
what
makes Edo bright. And seeing that
fight in a
scrimmage is what Tracen's all
about!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Give the okay and let 'em compete
already!
C'mon, we gotta settle this,
Edo-style!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I find myself wrangled into
overseeing the
scrimmage!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
There ya go, good start! Now look alive
and
proud! Feel that sunshine beamin'
down on ya!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Go gooo! Close that gap! Hey, you in
the lead!
Don't just give up!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Maan, whatta race that was! Came down
to a
nose too! And just lookit those
bright smiles on
their faces!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Us Umamusume were born for this stuff.
Now, to
wrap things up nicely...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Good thinkin'. Then let's finish this with
some
stylin' clappin'!
choice_data_list: 健闘を讃えてあげよう
飲み物を差し入れるとか

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You two put on one helluva show! As
thanks, on
my mark, let's all clap in
unison to finish off!
Yooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following Inari One's cue, the three of
them clap
their hands together in sync,
sending a clear
sound ringing through
the clear blue sky.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, nothin' like a cold drink to
wash away
any bitter feelings, right?
Good thinkin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two! How'd ya like a nice cold
drink to
cool off?!
